name: Water Bowls
description: Waterbowl in the shape of a lifering, perfect for medium to smaller crabs. Comes in four colours, made with safe non-toxic paint. Smooth surface for easy cleaning, and the bowl has a heavy design to prevent the Krabz from tipping it over.

reviews.comment: Great for childrens setups, but look strange if you want a more natural setup.
Cute design, strong and the kids love watching the crabs bathe in them!
They are too small for jumbo crabs and the paint chips off easily. They are also childish in design, and ruin natural setups.
